head: e001952bc42e6711b4582ae87e1ae0f010336a9e
disclosure: Historical W129/W136-W143 results known; schema and source inspected, no W144 trajectory metrics or corrections evaluated before declaration. Initial preflight compared 240 decoded frames against all 1631 stored hashes (harness range bug); retained failed preflight.json, corrected to source[79:319] before declaration. No source bytes changed.

regimes.S1: real_animcv_observation; frozen M1 RTMDet/RTMPose + S0 learned 3D, GT-free replay

frames.rule: action=source-78; action time=(action-1)/30; source nominal time=source/30; container quantization separately reported

metrics.position: Euclidean step and second difference (px observations; metres evaluated rig); acceleration second difference *900, speed step *30; no velocity-only error classification
metrics.rotation: SO(3) geodesic active local-to-parent rotation increment in degrees; object scale removed
metrics.source: raw landmarks xy pixel and detector confidence >=0.3; canonical virtual pelvis/thorax marked derived; unavailable or self-occluded never treated as GT
metrics.continuity: all 239 edges; 0.25/0.5/0.75/0.999 subframe samples; CONSTANT expected holds
metrics.2d_jumps: displacement >20 px/frame with adjacent valid confidence; flag only, not proof of error
metrics.geometry: recompute frozen fixed_slot for every prediction; Python rest-relative FK vs Blender heads/tails <=1e-5 m; local/parent parity; length constancy
metrics.camera: W143 frozen NOMINAL_UNCALIBRATED, no metric translation; report image-space background flow separately; no S1 reprojection fidelity gate

selection.baseline: top 5 left shoulder step destination frames, ties earlier; +/-3 frames; quiet=12-frame window with smallest summed left shoulder steps; large source motion=12-frame window with largest confident wrist pixel path; uncertain=12-frame window with most invalid input joints; ties earlier

counterfactual: for EVERY edge, hold one factor at previous value in current state; inject current factor into previous state; full actual Blender FK; factors object translation/rotation, spine_01, clavicles, left arm, thighs. Joint object+spine intervention and both conditional orders, never unique causal percentages. No saved diagnostic Actions.
synthetic: known camera/root transforms, torso articulation, upstream pose jump and duplicated-parent defect; numerical oracle only; no oracle S1 values
candidate_rule: At most one, only if identity/frame/axis/composition defect is demonstrated against frozen intended contract OR independent source/scene evidence constrains the corrective state without invented depth or pose. No correction based only on reduced steps; no smoothing/freeze as repair. If no supported correction, skip explicitly.
candidate_gates: verified mechanism and independent source constraint
new reversible copy, no historical change
judgment: SUPPORTED only mechanism + source-consistent real Blender improvement and all candidate gates; PARTIALLY_SUPPORTED partial attribution/improvement with unresolved questions; NOT_YET_SUPPORTED no useful source-consistent camera-anchored improvement; BLOCKED prerequisite failure. Diagnostic attribution separate from correction.
